description: This file contains Redux action creators and async logic for managing roles in the Mattermost application, including fetching roles by name or ID, editing roles, and loading roles if needed.

methods.name: getRolesByNames
methods.description: Fetches roles by their names using the client function and dispatches relevant Redux actions.

methods.name: getRoleByName
methods.description: Fetches a role by its name.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Fetches a role by its ID.

methods.name: editRole
methods.description: Edits a role with the provided role data.

methods.name: setPendingRoles
methods.description: Sets the list of pending roles in the Redux store.

methods.name: loadRolesIfNeeded
methods.description: Asynchronously loads roles if they are not already loaded, batching requests based on a maximum batch size.
